name: Underground utility network (georeferenced)
description: A non-cadastral topo-feature document — underground utility pipe segments as Solids, classified by assetCondition — proving the viewer needs no cadastral/WA vocabulary to render domain-specific styling rules. Georeferenced copy for the Cesium globe view: the original local coordinates (metres; x east, y north, z up, origin 0,0,0) are kept in each point's `place`, and `geometry` holds WGS84 lon/lat with ellipsoidal height, placing the local origin at 115.8605 E, 31.9535 S, 10 m below the ellipsoid (an exact east-north-up to geodetic conversion).
